whisper.transcript: If you stuck a needle into a dead spider? You could make its legs move again. Because when a spider dies, all its legs curl inward. You see, spiders use fluid pressure to straighten their legs, and when they die, that pressure disappears. So scientists attached a syringe to a dead spider and pumped air inside. Its legs suddenly spread open. But when they release the pressure, The legs clamped shut. They turned a dead spider into a working claw. and they actually used it to pick up another dead spider.
